decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template costs little to maintain and supports the firm's core shop-hosting business for agencies, so keeping it is cheap even though it was only mentioned in a blog-style note.
A responsive website template is a low-cost complement to managed CMS hosting and fits the established offer, so there is little reason to withdraw it within a year.
Premium support matches the firm's strategy of round-the-clock expert service and generates recurring revenue from agencies.
The version management tool has its own page and builds on the firm's management tools that cut recurring operational work, making it a core part of its platform innovation.
Although distant from the core offer, the data processing contract generator meets ongoing GDPR demand from hosting customers and costs little to run, so the firm is likely to keep it.
